description:
Four-time NBA champion, Golden State Warrior Draymond Green is back on the mic!

On the Draymond Green Show you’ll get raw reactions, in-depth game analysis, behind-the-scenes stories, and cultural opinions from one of basketball’s most outspoken voices. You’ll also hear candid conversations with teammates, rivals, and culture-shapers across sports, entertainment, and business. No topic is off limits.

Whether you love him or love to hate him, you’re getting the truth — not the takes.
New episodes of The Draymond Green Show every week — unfiltered, unapologetic, and all facts.
